races.name: Dundalk Stadium Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict:
Pretty useful handicapper SONORAN is a potential class act in a claimer. Denis Hogan pair Venetian and Justenzia may give the Ger Lyons runner most to think about..

  1. SONORAN (IRE)
  2. VENETIAN (IRE)
  3. JUSTENZIA (IRE)

races.name: Halloween Mid-Term Racing At Dundalk Handicap
races.verdict:
COASTING is given a chance to build on his promising 7f course second earlier in the month. Willie McCreery's Bella Colombia caught the eye at Leopardstown recently and this former C&D scorer is second choice. Moyassr's good C&D record brings him into the reckoning, while the selection's stablemate Gavoo is well treated if a return to all-weather sparks a revival.

  1. COASTING (IRE)
  2. BELLA COLOMBIA (IRE)
  3. MOYASSR (IRE)

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SONIC SABIHA has a fair bit to find with the standard-setter Nevermindtherain, but she looked unlucky not to win over C&D on her most recent outing and gives the impression there's an even bigger performance in her. Aidan O'Brien newcomer Slightly makes plenty of appeal on paper, while Golden Alibi showed promise in the face of a stiff task at Fairyhouse last month and is open to improvement.

  1. SONIC SABIHA (IRE)
  2. NEVERMINDTHERAIN (IRE)
  3. SLIGHTLY (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
MUDYRK left his debut form well behind when runner-up to a now-useful type at Fairyhouse in June and he is taken to go one better after a break. The main dangers could be Golden Idol and Tantardini, who both showed encouragement first time out and are potential improvers for their respected yards.

  1. MUDYRK (IRE)
  2. GOLDEN IDOL (IRE)
  3. TANTARDINI (USA)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BATTLEFORSUPREMACY got back on track in first-time blinkers (retained here) when fourth of 14 over C&D on most recent outing and a reproduction of that form may well suffice. Last-time-out winner Jazzit and Liamo head the opposition.

  1. BATTLEFORSUPREMACY (IRE)
  2. JAZZIT
  3. LIAMO (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Three-time C&D winner UNA MATATA is very well treated on her form here earlier in the year and having produced her best effort for some time when third over C&D 12 days ago, she could well be ready to strike. Leannespour remains pretty lightly raced and isn't one to be writing off from her basement mark, whilst Expound finds himself operating from a career-low mark if bouncing back over this shorter trip. Roman Harry completes the shortlist.

  1. UNA MATATA (IRE)
  2. LEANNESPOUR (IRE)
  3. EXPOUND

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
CRAYONS IN THE SKY represents some strong form lines and posted her best effort yet when runner up over C&D on her penultimate start. Far from disgraced when fourth latest, this may well be the day she gets off the mark. Normanton rates a likely improver with his debut run behind him and is next best ahead of Belle Parvenue.

  1. CRAYONS IN THE SKY
  2. NORMANTON (IRE)
  3. BELLE PARVENUE (IRE)

races.name: Happy Halloween Handicap
races.verdict:
Following back-to-back victories at this course, GALLO DELL CIELO made it 3 wins from 4 starts when winning at Tramore in August and he's shaped well both outings since. He is taken to add to his tally, with Coolnagrattan next best as he makes only his second handicap start, ahead of Wandering Rocks.

  1. GALLO DELL CIELO (IRE)
  2. COOLNAGRATTAN (IRE)
  3. WANDERING ROCKS

races.name: St. Austell Brewery Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
VANGO CAN GO made a bright start in bumpers last season and is a horse to follow now going jumping up in trip. He can make a successful reappearance, although Crystal Orchard's hurdling experience gives him an edge and he returns with his stable flying.

  1. VANGO CAN GO (IRE)
  2. CRYSTAL ORCHARD (IRE)
  3. SIRGREG

races.name: Wollens Full Spectrum Law Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The promising REAL QUARTZ is taken to remain unbeaten. Fellow 6-y-o Vol Royale had a productive novice campaign and can follow Dan Skelton's charge home.

  1. REAL QUARTZ (IRE)
  2. VOL ROYALE (IRE)
  3. CALVINO (IRE)

races.name: Brewers Decorating Centres Albany Derby Female Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
With the Joe Tizzard stable going great guns a narrow vote goes the way of the reappearing STAR OF AFFINITY under Lilly Pinchin. C&D specialist It's A Breeze rates an obvious danger under top amateur Gina Andrews, who is bidding for her 100th winner under Rules. Dwight K Schrute fell on his previous attempt over fences but is very competitive off this sort of mark over hurdles and the Jamie Snowden yard is enjoying a fine autumn.

  1. STAR OF AFFINITY (IRE)
  2. IT'S A BREEZE (IRE)
  3. DWIGHT K SCHRUTE

races.name: Passage House Hotel South Devon Gateway Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
In a trappy race a chance is taken on Fergal O'Brien's returning new recruit ROCK ON COWBOY, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting speak in his favour. Western Cross is a lightly-raced type who could have more to offer this season and is next on the list. Dan Skelton's new recruit Paddockwood would also firmly enter calculations should the market vibes be strong.

  1. ROCK ON COWBOY (IRE)
  2. WESTERN CROSS (IRE)
  3. PADDOCKWOOD (FR)

races.name: Persimmon Homes Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OPENING BID is approaching 12 but was better than the result on his recent comeback over hurdles at Chepstow for the red-hot Tizzard stable and should be up to exploiting a lenient chase mark if building on that. Centara is a 4-time C&D winner under Jay Tidball and is very interesting back under him for the first time in a while. The Four Sixes is another to note.

  1. OPENING BID
  2. CENTARA (IRE)
  3. THE FOUR SIXES (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FAIRYE FORTH is an appealing chasing debutant and is taken to make a winning start in this sphere for the in-form Rebecca Curtis. Mask of Zorro should do well over fences and is a big danger, while Badbury Rings can build on his opening effort in this sphere at Worcester if his jumping becomes more polished.

  1. FAIRYE FORTH (IRE)
  2. MASK OF ZORRO (IRE)
  3. BADBURY RINGS

races.name: Thank You & Farewell Dr. Tim Tilsley Open Maiden NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THE GIFT SHOP hammered a next-time-out winner on sole outing in Irish points and, having subsequently transferred to the Skeltons, he makes obvious appeal. Par Avion has already run to a level good enough to win plenty of bumpers and merits respect for a yard that took this race in 2024 with unbeaten hurdler Idaho Sun. De Inovator is another to note on his first start under Rules having joined a good outfit.

  1. THE GIFT SHOP (FR)
  2. PAR AVION
  3. DE INOVATOR (IRE)

races.name: Agri Day At Huntingdon Racecourse 10 November Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
JIMMYJEROO finished a good second at Hereford on his final start last season and, with his reappearance run behind him, he is fancied to get back to winning ways with Patrick Mullins booked for the ride. Majestic Moment could be next best on the back of his recent outing, ahead of Anytrixwilldo.

  1. JIMMYJEROO
  2. MAJESTIC MOMENT (IRE)
  3. ANYTRIXWILLDO (IRE)

races.name: Peterborough Chase 6 December 2026 Book Now Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CURRENT EDITION has shown promise when finishing second both starts over hurdles so far, leading until after the last at Uttoxeter on his return, and he could be ready to go one better for his in-form yard. Scotto is feared most having won both of his outings in bumpers, with Premiere Ligne also considered.

  1. CURRENT EDITION (IRE)
  2. SCOTTO (IRE)
  3. PREMIERE LIGNE (FR)

races.name: 2026/27 Annual Badges Now On Sale At Huntingdon Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
PORTER IN THE PARK should be sharper now and she's well treated if coming back to last season's form. Most of her rivals have something to prove but likely front runner Betty's Tiara at least arrives in decent heart.

  1. PORTER IN THE PARK (IRE)
  2. BETTY'S TIARA
  3. BELLA CIVENA (IRE)

races.name: Host Your Conference At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SERAPHIC was suited by the emphasis on speed when recording a first hurdles win on these shores at Stratford recently, but he still did well to come from last and looks capable of defying a 6 lb higher mark providing this doesn't come too soon just 11 days on. Gallivanted should strip fitter for his recent run and make more of an impact in this weaker affair, while Zafaan shouldn't be judged too harshly on his latest effort on the level and remains of interest back over hurdles.

  1. SERAPHIC (IRE)
  2. GALLIVANTED (FR)
  3. ZAFAAN (IRE)

races.name: Hospitality At Huntingdon Racecourse Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KNIGHTON showed up well for a long way on his return from 5 months off at Market Rasen recently and is put forward as the answer from the same mark, given he's entitled to strip fitter for the outing and remains relatively unexposed. Calibos and Zaraquelle may also have their best days as hurdlers ahead of them, so they are feared most.

  1. KNIGHTON
  2. CALIBOS
  3. ZARAQUELLE (FR)

races.name: Christmas Parties 2026 At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CLAP OF THUNDER failed to justify favouritism on his chase bow at Market Rasen when last seen on Boxing Day, but it was still an encouraging effort, so he gets the vote with progress likely and his yard in good form. Nazare jumped much better when scoring on his second chase start at Southwell so is another to consider, while Scavengers Reign is an interesting newcomer over fences.

  1. CLAP OF THUNDER (IRE)
  2. NAZARE (FR)
  3. SCAVENGERS REIGN (IRE)

races.name: Advertise At Huntingdon Racecourse Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A bumper featuring a few closely rated on Timeform pre-ratings, with ARM’S OF AN ANGEL edging the vote after making an encouraging enough start under Rules when fifth at Ludlow back in late-April, her yard having also sent out a tidy winner in this sphere earlier in the month. Persian Art and the penalised Seedling head the dangers in that order.

  1. ARM'S OF AN ANGEL (IRE)
  2. PERSIAN ART (IRE)
  3. SEEDLING

races.name: Racedays For 9 Pound At Nottingham Racecourse Nursery
races.verdict:
WOLF'S GALLOP was a fine second on deep ground at Ffos Las on his latest start, pulling clear of a next-time-out winner in third in the process and he could be up to going a place better here. Dowman was below par on his previous attempt on testing ground but George Boughey is evidently happy to let him have another go and he'll be thereabouts if handling conditions.

  1. WOLF'S GALLOP
  2. DOWMAN (IRE)
  3. SUE'S LAST CHANCE (IRE)

races.name: Halloween Spooktacular Fireworks 31st Oct Handicap
races.verdict:
DURAN has been running quite well since the visor went on and perhaps a drop to a 0-70 for the first time can see him get his head back in front. Irish raider Alnofoor relishes the mud and is second choice ahead of Rambuso Creek, a dual course scorer this season.

  1. DURAN (IRE)
  2. ALNOFOOR
  3. RAMBUSO CREEK (IRE)

races.name: EBF Stallions Golden Horn Maiden Stakes (C & G)
races.verdict:
FULCRUM shaped with significant promise in a C&D novice a fortnight ago and expected to build on that, he'll take some stopping. Silent Force has shown more than enough to think he can win races, while the 3 newcomers all have something to recommend them on paper.

  1. FULCRUM
  2. SILENT FORCE (IRE)
  3. NOBLE MARINER (IRE)

races.name: Robin Hood Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
ROOM SERVICE has looked better than ever in a light campaign for this yard and he just about sets the standard, with Centigrade and Ebt's Guard close behind.

  1. ROOM SERVICE (IRE)
  2. CENTIGRADE (IRE)
  3. EBT'S GUARD

races.name: EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
STAR ROSE made a promising start when beaten just 4 lengths by the Futurity runner-up Gran Dia on debut at Salisbury 4 weeks ago. That wasn't unexpected given her strength in the betting that day and she can take this with improvement forthcoming. Flash of Colour, High Society (a stable companion of the selection) and Lady Bb are appealing newcomers.

  1. STAR ROSE (GER)
  2. FLASH OF COLOUR
  3. HIGH SOCIETY

races.name: Racing TV Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A competitive staying handicap. HEROICS boasts a largely progressive profile and gets a narrow vote over fellow 3-y-o Gaspacho. The front-running Maxident revels in this sort of ground and is another likely to give it a good shot.

  1. HEROICS
  2. GASPACHO
  3. MAXIDENT

races.name: AJA Championships Finale Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
The reliable SWEET KISS is capable of winning back-to-back so she looks a solid option, with Wellwhatshappenin and Artavian others to consider in an open finale.

  1. SWEET KISS
  2. WELLWHATSHAPPENIN (IRE)
  3. ARTAVIAN

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
The opener can go the way of LAZZAR, who shaped encouragingly having his fifth run for this yard when not beaten far at Southwell earlier in the month. From his reduced mark, he gets the vote ahead of Insuspense who has also made a positive start for her new trainer. Marianne Mozart completes the shortlist.

  1. LAZZAR (IRE)
  2. INSUSPENSE
  3. MARIANNE MOZART (IRE)

races.name: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
GIRLS ALLOWED proved a different proposition when making all for a wide-margin success over C&D last time and is fancied to score again now that she's up and running. Seapearl failed to give her running when last seen but is worth another chance making only her second handicap start, with Wild Rosie also in the mix.

  1. GIRLS ALLOWED (IRE)
  2. SEAPEARL
  3. WILD ROSIE

races.name: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
CROWN THE FUTURE has proved better than ever on his last 2 starts, successful at Wolverhampton before finishing clear of the rest when second at Southwell 4 days ago. He is taken to quickly resume winning ways, at the chief expense of Roccobear who is worth another try at 1m. Fizzy Bear is another to consider if lining up here.

  1. CROWN THE FUTURE (IRE)
  2. ROCCOBEAR (IRE)
  3. FIZZY BEAR (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
THESPIAN QUEEN showed improved form back at this course when runner-up 16 days ago, beaten only by the odds-on favourite, and she can build on that effort to go one better. A pair of the newcomers could provide the biggest threat, Lady Margo the pick for second ahead of Perfectly Adorable.

  1. THESPIAN QUEEN
  2. LADY MARGO (IRE)
  3. PERFECTLY ADORABLE

races.name: Set Your Limits With Unibet Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
GOOMAH has shown improved form with placed efforts both starts for current trainer, over this C&D on the first occasion, and with her stable continuing to go well she could be ready to open her account. Maria Da Silva is next on the list for her leading yard, while Amarachi has been in good heart since the application of headgear.

  1. GOOMAH (IRE)
  2. MARIA DA SILVA (IRE)
  3. AMARACHI (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Nursery
races.verdict:
PURE MINT showed something like his debut form at the second attempt when finding only one too good on nursery bow at Nottingham 4 weeks ago, pulling nicely clear of a next-time-out winner in the process. He could well be the answer under Oisin Murphy, with Arthur Carrot and Henley On Thames just 2 potential dangers in what is a competitive affair.

  1. PURE MINT (IRE)
  2. ARTHUR CARROT
  3. HENLEY ON THAMES (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARABIAN SUMMER returned from 2 years on the sidelines with a promising second at Southwell earlier this month and provided this doesn't come too soon, she looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to make it third time lucky. Newcomer Tausret and Poor Relation may provide chief resistance to Saeed bin Suroor's filly.

  1. ARABIAN SUMMER (IRE)
  2. TAUSRET
  3. POOR RELATION (FR)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Racing Bet Builder Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
STAR TIME was impressive when winning a tactical contest in such style from off the pace here last time so a 7 lb rise may not prove beyond him. Winged One is interesting back on all-weather, while Forever Penywern and Brighton View had possible excuses last time.

  1. STAR TIME
  2. WINGED ONE (IRE)
  3. FOREVER PENYWERN

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive finale with the narrow vote in favour of STRONG VOICE. James Horton's 3-y-o has found only one too good on 2 of his last 3 starts and wasn't seen to very best effect when fourth over C&D 3 weeks ago. He's fancied to go well from a handy draw, with hat-trick seeking Whitesnake, Split Elevens and Herculeus others to consider.

  1. STRONG VOICE (IRE)
  2. WHITESNAKE
  3. SPLIT ELEVENS

races.name: Hollywoodbets Durbanville Welcomes You Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
SNOW SNIPER looks marginally the pick in this field but this is an open race. Tequila Tango gets the nod among the remainder, while Stitchintime commands a second look as well.

  1. SNOW SNIPER (SAF)
  2. TEQUILA TANGO (SAF)
  3. STITCHINTIME (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Tote www.tote.co.za Class 4
races.verdict:
AYZAL is up to taking this with a bit in hand given she figures on a very hand mark. Kelp Forest is also fancied to take a hand, while Gold Dust edges it so far as third place is concerned.

  1. AYZAL (SAF)
  2. KELP FOREST (SAF)
  3. GOLD DUST (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Magic Mile Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
SIGN OF SPRING just about edges it as the selection on the back of another solid effort over C&D 2 weeks ago. Gimme Perfect is feared most, though Jack A Dandy commands respect as well.

  1. SIGN OF SPRING (SAF)
  2. GIMME PERFECT (SAF)
  3. JACK A DANDY (SAF)

races.name: Blue Hen Racing Syndicate Class 3
races.verdict:
HERO'S JOURNEY is running very well right now and is going to be hard to beat. Mente Et Manu is the rational second choice, while Pomp It Up is the other candidate for the three.

  1. HERO'S JOURNEY (SAF)
  2. MENTE ET MANU (SAF)
  3. POMP IT UP (SAF)

races.name: Perfectly Placed Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
SABRE WING is selected having improved again when runner-up on handicap debut over C&D 3 weeks ago Saachi One is foremost among the dangers, while Cliffscape also commands respect.

  1. SABRE WING (SAF)
  2. SAACHI ONE (SAF)
  3. CLIFFSCAPE (SAF)

races.name: www.racecoast.co.za C Stakes
races.verdict:
CATCH ME looks marginally the pick of this bunch but this is more competitive than the numbers suggest. Danny Atlas is next pick, while Havoc is not out of it for third place.

  1. CATCH ME (SAF)
  2. DANNY ATLAS (SAF)
  3. HAVOC (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Turf Luck D Stakes
races.verdict:
ELUSIVE GIFT continues to operate somewhere near current peak and seems the one they have to beat. Christmas Rose is most likely the biggest danger, while Pacific Waters can't be ruled out.

  1. ELUSIVE GIFT (SAF)
  2. CHRISTMAS ROSE (SAF)
  3. PACIFIC WATERS (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Open Maiden
races.verdict:
LORELEY'S ROCK holds a sizeable advantage on form and sets a high standard. Peace Sign is fancied as the best bet for second, while Gimme More Apache is another with place prospects.

  1. LORELEY'S ROCK (SAF)
  2. PEACE SIGN (SAF)
  3. GIMME MORE APACHE (SAF)
